استذنبتا (form X)
# اِسْتَذْنَبَتَا (istaḏnabatā) /is.tað.na.ba.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِسْتَذْنَبَ (istaḏnaba)
# اُسْتُذْنِبَتَا (ustuḏnibatā) /us.tuð.ni.ba.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِسْتَذْنَبَ (istaḏnaba)
